concern: The interrogation loses pressure after the first reversal.

intent.desired_effect: sustained entrapment without making Mara overtly aggressive

finding.summary: Pressure appears to flatten after the first reversal because the tactic and leverage relationship stop changing while information continues to accumulate.

alternatives: The stasis may be intentional if the desired effect is entrapment rather than escalation.
limitations: No human-calibrated claim is made that a reader will feel bored or tense.
